activity.notes: Sebastião José de Carvalho e Melo, later Marquis of Pombal, became the dominant minister of Joseph I. The Portuguese Parliament describes the king as entrusting him with governance and appointing him Primeiro-Ministro; the 1756-1777 interval represents the period in which he headed the kingdom's government as Secretary of State for Internal Affairs, rather than treating his noble title itself as an office.

sources.title: Marquês de Pombal — Assembleia da República
sources.citation_text: Portugal's Parliament identifies Sebastião José de Carvalho e Melo as Marquis of Pombal, records his 1750 appointment as Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs and War, and states that Joseph I later entrusted him with governance as Primeiro-Ministro.
